title.zh: Tenstorrent 完成 15 亿美元 E 轮融资，估值 62 亿美元
title.en: Tenstorrent closes $1.5B Series E at $6.2B valuation

current_state.zh: Tether Capital participated in Tenstorrent’s $1.5 billion Series E funding round, valuing the AI computing company at $6.2 billion as Tether expands its AI strategy into processors and computing systems.
current_state.en: Tether Capital participated in Tenstorrent’s $1.5 billion Series E funding round, valuing the AI computing company at $6.2 billion as Tether expands its AI strategy into processors and computing systems.

updates.title_zh: Tenstorrent 估值达 62 亿美元，加速扩展开放权重 AI 芯片业务
updates.title_en: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
updates.what_changed_zh:
AI 芯片公司 Tenstorrent 于 10 月 19 日宣布完成 15 亿美元 E 轮融资，投后估值达 62 亿美元。本轮由 Trace Capital 和 Innovation X 领投，新老投资者参投，包括 ARK Invest、富达管理与研究公司、摩根士丹利、闪迪、普徕仕、Tether Investments、Virtu Financial 和 XTX Markets。

Tenstorrent 表示，在今年早些时候收到收购意向后，此轮融资旨在保持公司独立，使 AI 加速器市场在英伟达之外保留一家替代供应商。公司计划用这笔资金大规模部署 Galaxy 服务器，服务开放权重的大语言模型和视频生成模型。

投资方名单还包括 Agostinelli Group、Brett Barna、Cadence Ventures、Eclipse、Maverick Silicon、Protagonist、Troluce Capital 和 Tether Investments。除服务器部署外，Tenstorrent 还将把资金用于向自研芯片的客户授权其 AI 和 CPU 知识产权。
updates.what_changed_en:
AI chip company Tenstorrent closed a $1.5 billion Series E at a $6.2 billion post-money valuation, the company announced on October 19. The round was led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, with participation from new and existing investors including ARK Invest, Fidelity Management & Research, Morgan Stanley, Sandisk, T. Rowe Price, Tether Investments, Virtu Financial and XTX Markets.

Tenstorrent said it raised the money to stay independent after drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, keeping an alternative supplier of AI accelerators outside the Nvidia orbit. The company plans to use the proceeds to deploy its Galaxy servers at scale for open-weight large language and video generation models.

The investor list also includes Agostinelli Group, Brett Barna, Cadence Ventures, Eclipse, Maverick Silicon, Protagonist, Troluce Capital and Tether Investments. Beyond server deployments, Tenstorrent will put funding toward licensing its AI and CPU intellectual property to customers designing their own chips.

updates.background_zh: Tenstorrent 一直在将其 RISC-V CPU 与 AI 核心产品化并对外授权，LG 和现代汽车均为其授权客户；EE Times 在 2025 年 9 月报道称，当时公司大部分订单来自 IP 授权交易。其 Galaxy 产品线包括基于 Wormhole 的服务器和较新的 Galaxy Blackhole 机型，后者在 6U 机箱内最多集成 32 颗 Blackhole ASIC，并可组成四机超级集群；Cirrascale Cloud Services 已于 2026 年 5 月将 Galaxy Blackhole 服务器引入其云平台。
updates.background_en: Tenstorrent has been productizing its RISC-V CPU and AI cores as licensable IP, with LG and Hyundai among its licensees; EE Times reported in September 2025 that most of the company's bookings at that time came from IP deals. Its Galaxy line spans Wormhole-based servers and the newer Galaxy Blackhole variant, which packs up to 32 Blackhole ASICs into a 6U chassis and is sold as a four-unit supercluster option; Cirrascale Cloud Services added Galaxy Blackhole servers to its cloud in May 2026.
updates.market_impact_zh: 与加密市场的直接关联在于 Tether Investments 的参投，这意味着这家稳定币发行方将储备资金配置到私募 AI 算力基础设施，而非数字资产持仓。对更广泛的加密市场而言，这笔交易更多是对去中心化 AI 算力叙事的情绪面传导，并未改变任何代币的基本面或流动性。
updates.market_impact_en: The direct crypto link is the participation of Tether Investments, which extends the stablecoin issuer's deployment of reserves into private AI compute infrastructure rather than digital-asset holdings. For crypto markets more broadly, the deal is a sentiment read-through for decentralized AI compute narratives rather than a change in any token's fundamentals or liquidity.
